metadata.title: Infant of Prague Novena
metadata.description: Traditional nine-day novena to the Divine Infant Jesus of Prague seeking His mercy, blessings, and intercession.
metadata.usage: Prayed for nine consecutive days while presenting a personal intention.

template.opening: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
template.introduction: O Divine Infant Jesus, I come before You with confidence, trusting in Your infinite mercy and love. Through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I place before You all my needs and intentions.
template.daily_prayer:
O Jesus, who has said, "Ask and you shall receive, seek and you shall find, knock and it shall be opened to you," through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I knock, I seek and I ask that my prayer may be granted.

(Mention your request here)

O Jesus, who has said, "All that you ask of the Father in My Name, He will grant you," through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I humbly and urgently ask Your Father in Your Name that my prayer be granted.

(Mention your request here)

O Jesus, who has said, "Heaven and earth shall pass away, but My words shall not pass away," through the intercession of Mary, Your Most Holy Mother, I place my confidence in You that my prayer will be granted.

(Mention your request here)

Divine Infant Jesus, I know You love me and would never leave me. I thank You for Your close presence in my life.

Miraculous Infant, I believe in Your promise of peace, blessings, and freedom from want. I place every need and care into Your hands.

Lord Jesus, may I always trust in Your generous mercy and love. I want to honor and praise You now and forever.

Infant of Prague, have mercy on us.

Amen.
template.closing: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
